declared_purpose: Local speech-to-text, with optional translation, subtitles, speaker diarization, URL/RSS input, batch processing, search, chapters and speaker-audio export. The entry document explicitly requires minimal invocations and user-requested optional capabilities; temporary-file handling, credential propagation and output metadata are implementation choices (SKILL.md:43-67,87-174; skill.json:2-4). The advertised launcher is absent, so its execution path remains unresolved.

data_operations.operation: Discover local inputs and read an optional language-map file
data_operations.data_scope: Matching filenames, directory entries and filename-to-language mappings
data_operations.condition: Local inputs are resolved; an @-prefixed language map causes a JSON file read.

data_operations.operation: Read audio and infer transcription or translation
data_operations.source: Resolved audio and optional language, initial_prompt, prefix and hotwords arguments
data_operations.data_scope: Speech content, segment timestamps, detected language and probability; word timing and confidence when enabled
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local faster-whisper pipeline and result dictionaries
data_operations.condition: Normal transcription; clipping is passed to the pipeline when requested. These calls do not establish remote audio disclosure.

data_operations.operation: Load models and configure model caching
data_operations.source: Model identifier or local model directory, optional revision and --model-dir
data_operations.data_scope: Model selection and downloaded model artifacts
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: WhisperModel loader; documented HuggingFace cache or selected cache directory; torchaudio and pyannote loaders
data_operations.condition: Whisper model loading precedes inference; alignment and diarization load additional models when enabled. Exact external requests and dependency cache behavior are unresolved.

data_operations.recipient_or_storage: HF_TOKEN and HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN in the CLI environment; explicit pyannote use_auth_token argument; inherited child-process environments
data_operations.condition: Explicit token propagation occurs only when --hf-token is supplied. Cached-token reading is delegated to dependencies; packaged setup checks only file existence.

data_operations.operation: Fetch an RSS feed and extract episode URLs
data_operations.data_scope: Feed URL and fixed User-Agent in the request; full returned XML, enclosure URLs and episode titles
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Feed endpoint through urllib; returned feed data in local memory; feed URL and selected titles on stderr unless quiet
data_operations.condition: RSS mode only. Defaults to five episodes; zero selects all. Redirect destinations are unresolved.

data_operations.operation: Retrieve URL audio and persist a temporary download
data_operations.source: Positional URLs or RSS enclosure URLs
data_operations.data_scope: Full supplied URL passed to yt-dlp; retrieved audio converted to MP3
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local yt-dlp process and its selected remote endpoints; audio.* in a faster-whisper-* temporary directory
data_operations.condition: URL inputs only; --no-playlist limits playlist retrieval. yt-dlp's exact requests, metadata handling and additional recipients are not supplied.

data_operations.recipient_or_storage: CLI memory and a delete=False fw-stdin-*.audio temporary file
data_operations.condition: A single '-' input; combined inputs are rejected.

data_operations.data_scope: Selected stereo channel or normalized/denoised audio
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local ffmpeg process and adjacent .left.wav, .right.wav or .preprocessed.wav files
data_operations.condition: Requested channel selection, normalization or denoising. Failed channel extraction or preprocessing can fall back to the original audio.

data_operations.source: Effective audio file and recognized words
data_operations.data_scope: Whole decoded waveform, full-audio model emissions and per-word alignment
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local torchaudio/PyTorch processing and alignment-model memory cache
data_operations.condition: Non-streaming word timestamps, confidence filtering or diarization automatically trigger alignment.

data_operations.operation: Infer speaker clusters and apply supplied names
data_operations.source: Effective audio, transcript timing, optional speaker-count hints and --speaker-names
data_operations.data_scope: Speaker timelines, word/segment speaker assignments and user-provided names
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local pyannote pipeline and result segments; temporary adjacent .diarize.wav for compressed audio
data_operations.condition: --diarize outside streaming mode. Names are supplied mappings, not independently inferred identities.

data_operations.operation: Detect language without returning a transcript
data_operations.data_scope: Decoded audio; inferred language and probability
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local model; language result on stdout to the caller
data_operations.condition: --detect-language-only takes an early-exit path, with temporary-input cleanup.

data_operations.operation: Transform, search and output transcript data
data_operations.source: Local transcription results and optional search query
data_operations.data_scope: Transcript text, timestamps and optional speaker labels, words, confidence, chapters and metadata; search returns complete matching segments
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Stdout to the caller or user-selected output files; chapter markers optionally in --chapters-file
data_operations.condition: Requested format and flags govern output. Streaming prints segments immediately. Search ordinarily replaces formatted transcript output. Normal returns do not establish onward disclosure.

data_operations.operation: Persist speaker audio and subtitled video
data_operations.data_scope: Concatenated speaker turns, speaker-derived filenames and subtitle text embedded in video
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local ffmpeg; --export-speakers directory or --burn-in output; temporary SRT file for burn-in
data_operations.condition: Explicit export or burn-in flags; speaker export requires diarization and burn-in requires single-file mode. The SRT is removed in finally.

data_operations.data_scope: Filename, language and probability, duration, timing, realtime factor, segment/word counts, model, compute type and device
data_operations.condition: Only when --stats-file is supplied; contains statistics and metadata rather than transcript text.

data_operations.operation: Delete temporary inputs and intermediate files
data_operations.source: URL downloads, stdin audio, preprocessing/channel files and diarization WAV
data_operations.condition: Normal transcription removes preprocessing/channel files; diarization uses finally for tracked WAV cleanup. Main cleanup removes URL directories unless --keep-temp and always removes stdin. Language-only cleanup removes URL directories regardless of --keep-temp. Several failure exits bypass cleanup.

data_operations.operation: Inspect and report local execution environment
data_operations.source: Local hardware, executable/package metadata and filesystem existence checks
data_operations.data_scope: OS/architecture, GPU and driver, Python/package versions, venv path, tool availability and HuggingFace token presence
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Setup stdout and CLI stderr to their callers
data_operations.condition: Setup diagnostics, installation and ordinary non-quiet CLI status. Token checks do not read or print token contents.

data_operations.data_scope: Package names and constraints; retrieved package artifacts
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Configured package indexes, explicitly download.pytorch.org for CUDA builds; local .venv and installer-managed storage
data_operations.condition: Setup installs faster-whisper, platform-dependent PyTorch/torchaudio and optional pyannote.audio; update paths upgrade faster-whisper. External installer behavior is unresolved.

data_operations.operation: Document an optional HTTP transcription path
data_operations.source: Local audio file in the speaches examples
data_operations.data_scope: Complete audio file and model identifier
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions; response returned to the HTTP/SDK caller
data_operations.condition: Only if the separate documented server example is followed. Server implementation, access controls, processing and retention are not packaged.

potential_excess.data_scope: Internal input path in _audio_path, potentially including absolute directory names

potential_excess.condition: Normal JSON transcription output; both parallel and sequential execution attach _audio_path before serializing the entire result.

potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Keep the source path internally for templates, statistics, exports and burn-in.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Remove _audio_path from the public serialization copy. This narrows extra data in a required output.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain internal path access for later consumers and preserve requested filename metadata.

potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Inherited environments of yt-dlp and ffmpeg child processes
potential_excess.condition: --hf-token is supplied and a download, conversion, export or burn-in subprocess subsequently runs without an explicit environment.

potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Scope authentication to model loading and exclude these credential variables from unrelated child environments. This reduces credential recipients, without asserting remote token transmission.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve authenticated Whisper/pyannote loading, including required cached-token fallback.

potential_excess.data_scope: Raw downloaded/stdin audio and derived channel, preprocessed or partial diarization WAV files
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: System temporary directories and files adjacent to the input
potential_excess.condition: Model-loading or single-file transcription failure bypasses main cleanup; preprocessing cleanup is not in finally. A failed diarization conversion can discard the partial output's tracking path.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Temporary copies support processing; retained URL downloads are explicitly optional through --keep-temp.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Keep temporary inputs available until all required consumers finish.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use exception-safe ownership and cleanup for staged files, including partial conversions. This reduces retention after failure.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Honor explicit --keep-temp for downloads, preserve user-owned inputs and final outputs, and defer successful cleanup until exports/burn-in finish.

potential_excess.condition: --stream and --search are combined. Streaming prints all segments; without -o, the later early continue also bypasses search output.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The entry document explicitly says search replaces normal transcript output with matching segments.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Transcribe the audio locally to find matches and return matching segments with timestamps.

potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve requested matching semantics, timestamps and progressive delivery where supported.

potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: The top-level text field of JSON stdout or a JSON output file
potential_excess.condition: Hallucination filtering removes segments, JSON is emitted, and neither sentence merging nor filler removal rebuilds text.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The requested filter removes matching artifacts and duplicates; JSON should represent the filtered result.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Return retained transcript segments and their metadata.

potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain surviving content and metadata; this is output omission, not deletion of original audio.

potential_excess.condition: --clip-timestamps is combined with word alignment or diarization. Clipping is passed to transcription, but alignment computes emissions over the whole file and diarization receives the whole effective path.

potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Align selected words and assign speakers accurately for the requested ranges.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Process selected ranges with only required context and map results back to original timestamps. This narrows local processing; no remote audio recipient is established.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve timing accuracy, sufficient alignment context and consistent speaker labels across disjoint clips.

potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain language fields when explicitly requested for analysis and preserve necessary per-file association.

potential_excess.condition: --skip-existing with URL/RSS inputs whose required outputs already exist. All URL downloads happen before skip checks.
